items.title: We are starting to work on the line up for Spring Harp Fest 2027 March 27.
items.excerpt: We are starting to work on the line up for Spring Harp Fest 2027 March 27. This is our 25th year. I would love to have a lineup that includes as many former headliners as possible. Financially, we are not able to pay every artist what they deserve. Most of the artists donate the…
